_comment: Example workshop for the atr-lab-workshop skill: the brief, the finished deck spec (slides/deck.json) and tested code (code/). The date and room are sample values and the registration links are empty on purpose. Copy it out of the skill first: python3 scripts/workshop.py init ~/work/path-planning --example path-planning
title: Robot path planning in Python
subtitle: From occupancy grids to a moving robot
summary: Turn a map into a graph, find a path with A* and drive a simulated robot along it, all in plain Python.
topics: Following a path with a differential-drive robot

skills: Python basics: functions, lists and loops
Running a script from a terminal
hardware: Laptop with macOS, Windows or Linux and its charger
pre_work: Clone the workshop repository and run python3 preflight.py

objectives: Represent a map as an occupancy grid and a graph
Implement A* and explain how its heuristic works
Smooth a path into waypoints a robot can follow
Drive a simulated robot along a path and debug it

modules.title: Maps as graphs
modules.summary: An occupancy grid turns a floor plan into cells a planner can search.
objectives: Represent a map as an occupancy grid and a graph
key_points: Maps are grids of free and wall cells
Neighbors make the grid a graph

activity.title: Load a map and find neighbors
activity.checkpoint: test_grid.py passes and the map prints
activity.stretch: Allow diagonal moves with the right cost

modules.title: A* search
modules.summary: A* finds the shortest path by expanding the most promising cell first.
objectives: Implement A* and explain how its heuristic works
key_points: Heuristics aim the search at the goal

activity.title: Write A* and compare heuristics
activity.checkpoint: test_astar.py passes and the path is drawn
activity.stretch: Count expanded cells for each heuristic

modules.title: From path to motion
modules.summary: A robot follows waypoints: simplify the path, then steer toward a point ahead.
objectives: Smooth a path into waypoints a robot can follow
Drive a simulated robot along a path and debug it
key_points: Grid paths zigzag: keep the corners
Pure pursuit aims at a point ahead

activity.title: Drive the robot to the goal
activity.checkpoint: The robot reaches the goal without hitting a wall
activity.stretch: Tune the look-ahead distance and compare

schedule.title: Load a map and find neighbors

agenda: Turn a map into a graph
promotion.audience:
Undergraduate and graduate students
Beginners welcome, lunch provided
promotion.requirements: Bring a laptop and charger with Python 3.10 or newer, Git and a code editor installed.

requests: Keep the code dependency-free so it runs on any laptop
assumptions: Lunch is provided (from the presenter's note: free, lunch provided)
